# `nimbus`

Segment/quantify cells with Nimbus and build AnnData outputs

- Wrapper: [`job_nimbus.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_nimbus.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_segmentation`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.segmentation_nimbus`

## Inputs

- general.masks_folder, general.metadata_folder/panel.csv, general.metadata_folder/metadata.csv
- general.denoised_images_folder (or raw fallback per nimbus settings)

## Outputs

- nimbus.output_dir/ (default nimbus_output/) and general.celltable_folder/nimbus_cell_tables/
- segmentation.anndata_save_path or nimbus.anndata_output (default anndata.h5ad)
- optional segmentation.removed_markers_anndata_path + outputs/005_Quantification/<run_id>/

## Configuration

- general, segmentation, nimbus, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl nimbus
```
